corpus.title: Songs of Innocence and of Experience
corpus.edition: Text of the 1789 and 1794 illuminated printings, as reproduced in modern public-domain editions
corpus.author: William Blake

licence.name: Public domain
licence.note: William Blake died in 1827, so the work and this text are out of copyright worldwide. No modern editor's apparatus, notes or emendations are included: only the poems themselves. Where printings differ in punctuation, the reading given here is the plain one, recorded so a later correction can be traced.

corpus.description: Ten short poems, the pilot corpus. Chosen over a 150-chapter book because short, metrical, strongly rhythmic text is the hardest case for word accuracy and the easiest case for a reviewer to judge quickly.
